note: keys = app payload fields (PLAN §d) or GOLD panel ids (PLAN §a, listed in `panels`); values ≤ 1 line

tooltips.fair_open: MCX settlement × COMEX ratio × USD/INR ratio since the 23:30 close: where MCX should open, not where it will close.
tooltips.gap: Fair open − settlement, ₹ per 10 g. ×100 per GOLD lot, ×10 per GOLDM.
tooltips.comex_part: Share of the gap from world gold (COMEX move × ₹ per $1).
tooltips.inr_part: Share of the gap from the rupee (USD/INR move × ₹ per ₹1).
tooltips.rs_per_comex_dollar: ₹ per 10 g for each $1 move in COMEX ≈ settlement ÷ COMEX. ×100 per GOLD lot.
tooltips.rs_per_inr_rupee: ₹ per 10 g for each ₹1 move in USD/INR ≈ settlement ÷ USD/INR. A 1% rupee move ≈ ₹1.46 lakh per GOLD lot.
tooltips.implied_premium_pct: Deprecated alias (one release): MCX over landed COMEX before duty. Read basis_pct (vs duty-paid landed, 15% dated) instead.
tooltips.threshold: Chase limit: |open − fair| tolerance for OK. A house rule; unsupported by the accuracy log so far (26 Oct 2026: 3 days, 0% within ₹300). Arithmetic to read, not advice.
tooltips.baseline: The last completed MCX session's settlement: the VWAP of its last 30 min of Breeze 1-minute bars (VWAP30 PROXY), else the ICICI band midpoint (BAND PROXY).
tooltips.settlement_from_band: (band_low + band_high) ÷ 2 from ICICI's public security master.
tooltips.band_low: MCX daily lower limit (−3% of settlement); widened in steps after cooling periods.
tooltips.band_high: MCX daily upper limit (+3% of settlement).
tooltips.open_interest_lots: Yesterday's open interest in lots for this contract (ICICI master). No history yet.
tooltips.tips10: 10-year US real yield (TIPS): the fresher of the Treasury real curve and FRED DFII10, one value per page. The level link to gold broke in 2022.
tooltips.dxy: ICE dollar index (DX-Y.NYB daily bars). When only FRED's broad index is stored the tile says DTWEXBGS (≈ 1 week lag), never 'DXY'. Dollar down = gold up, usually.
tooltips.eurusd: Euro vs dollar (57.6% of DXY). The trigger level is your own setting, not evidence.
tooltips.silver: COMEX silver. Gold ÷ silver = the gold/silver ratio (60–80 normal; >90 risk-off).
tooltips.event_risk: Count of headlines carrying war/strike/sanction/margin/halt words (≤ 18 headlines). A keyword tally, not sentiment, not sizing advice. Heuristic.
tooltips.landed: COMEX × USD/INR × 10 ÷ 31.1035: ₹ per 10 g of pure gold before duty, GST or local premium.
tooltips.fair: Settlement scaled by COMEX and USD/INR moves since the close (same model as the Pre-Open desk).
tooltips.tick_value: ₹1 on the quote = this many ₹ per lot (lot grams ÷ quote grams).
tooltips.multiplier: Lot grams ÷ quote grams: ₹ of P&L per ₹1 of price per lot.
tooltips.notional: Price × multiplier × lots: the full value your margin controls.
tooltips.indicative_margin: Notional × exchange NRML margin % (Zerodha mirror, dated). Planning number; the broker's SPAN+ELM is the real one and changes daily.
tooltips.margin_pct_indicative: Exchange NRML margin from the Zerodha mirror: 9.25% of notional on every gold contract (25 Oct 2026), dated. Special and delivery margins come on top.
tooltips.round_trip_total: All charges to open and close (exchange, CTT on sell, stamp on buy, SEBI, brokerage, GST). ≈ 26 ticks on GOLD.
tooltips.breakeven_ticks: Ticks the price must move in your favour to cover round-trip costs.
tooltips.ctt: Commodities Transaction Tax, 0.01% of the sell-side turnover (squared-off futures).
tooltips.exchange_txn: MCX transaction fee, ₹2.10 per lakh (0.0021%) each side.
tooltips.stamp: Stamp duty, 0.002% on the buy side.
tooltips.sebi: SEBI turnover fee, ₹10 per crore, both sides.
tooltips.gst: 18% on brokerage + exchange fee + SEBI fee.
tooltips.expiry_source: observed = ICICI's security master; computed = the rule (5th / month-end, previous business day if closed); requested = your pick.
tooltips.purity: Fineness of the deliverable metal, per family card: 995 (GOLD, GOLDM), 999 (TEN, PETAL, GUINEA). The basis divides by landed × purity/1000 (landed is fine gold; D1).
tooltips.delivery_unit: What you receive or deliver if the position reaches expiry.
tooltips.cycle: Contract months listed: GOLD bimonthly (Feb/Apr/Jun/Aug/Oct/Dec), others monthly.
tooltips.evening_close: 23:30 IST while New York is on daylight time, 23:55 otherwise (switches 2 Nov 2026). Settlement = last-30-minute VWAP.
tooltips.segment: Morning (09:00–17:00) or evening (17:00–close); the split only matters on partial holidays.
tooltips.mean_abs_error: Average |actual open − fair open| over logged days.
tooltips.naive_mean_abs_error: Average |actual open − yesterday's settlement|: the benchmark the model must beat.
tooltips.within_threshold_pct: Share of days the open was within the chase limit of fair.
tooltips.bias: Average (actual − fair): + means MCX opens above fair on average.
tooltips.p90_abs_error: 90% of days the miss was at most this.
tooltips.mm_net: Managed-money long − short (spreads excluded), COMEX gold futures, as of Tuesday. The swing speculative position.
tooltips.pm_net: Producer/merchant net (miners, refiners, jewellers hedging): structurally short, small in gold.
tooltips.sd_net: Swap-dealer net (banks hedging OTC client longs): the bulk of the commercial short.
tooltips.or_net: Other-reportables net (family offices, prop, unregistered funds): a second structural long in 2025–26.
tooltips.nr_net: Non-reportable (small trader) net = OI minus reportables.
tooltips.delta_long: Change in long contracts on the week: negative = longs closed, positive = new longs.
tooltips.delta_short: Change in short contracts on the week: negative = shorts covered, positive = new shorts.
tooltips.cot_index_52w: Where today's net sits in its 52-report range, 0–100. Crowdedness, not a signal: no forecasting power 2006–2026 (G-STUDY). Context only.
tooltips.cot_index_156w: Same over 3 years (156 reports). Context only.
tooltips.traders_long: Number of reportable traders long in this category: breadth of the position.
tooltips.conc_gross_le_4: Share of open interest held by the 4 largest traders (gross). Gold's short side is always concentrated (banks).
tooltips.oi_all: Total open interest, all months (COT weekly; exchange daily). Sum months; never read a single month across a roll.
tooltips.oi_change: Change in total OI vs prior day/week; compare with its 20-period average, and ignore expiry days.
tooltips.quadrant: Price Δ vs OI Δ: long build-up / short covering / short build-up / long unwinding. No label until the OI file lands (CME T+1 ≈ 15:30 IST). Description, not forecast.
tooltips.registered_oz: COMEX vault gold with a warehouse receipt: deliverable today.
tooltips.coverage_ratio: Registered oz ÷ (OI × 100 oz). Deliveries are 1–3% of OI a month: context only.
tooltips.etf_tonnes: Gold held by the fund (allocated bars). Daily at the US close; flows are contemporaneous with price.
tooltips.lbma_turnover_usd_bn: LBMA-i weekly gold turnover in $ bn (12-week moving average), published weekly. Activity, not positions: there is no COT for London.
tooltips.vault_tonnes: Gold in London vaults incl. the Bank of England, monthly, ~1-month lag (9,821 t end-Sep 2026).
tooltips.sge_premium_usd: Shanghai Au99.99 in $/oz minus the world price. Positive = China pulling metal; depends on import quotas.
tooltips.duty_rate: Customs duty in force: BCD 10% + AIDC 5% = 15% since 13 May 2026 (Notification 16/2026-Customs). Dated; confirm at CBIC in a browser (owner action O-3).
tooltips.usdinr: Rupees per dollar (Yahoo INR=X); before 09:00 IST the last evening print (no overnight feed), onshore after; FBIL reference at 13:30.
tooltips.gsr: Gold ÷ silver price ratio. 60–80 normal; >90 risk-off/deflation; <60 reflation.
tooltips.gvz: Cboe gold implied volatility (GLD options). 14–20 normal, >30 stress.
tooltips.realised_vol_20d: Annualised standard deviation of the last 20 daily returns.
tooltips.atr14_rupees: 14-day average true range in ₹ per quote unit: the unit for stops and sizing.
tooltips.carry_ann: Annualised % between two contract months = ln(F2/F1) × 365 ÷ days. A long pays it at each roll.
tooltips.max_lots_at_risk_pct: floor(account × risk% ÷ (k × ATR × multiplier)). Often 0 for GOLD at retail sizes: that is the point.
tooltips.hedge_usdinr_lots: USD/INR futures ($1,000) to neutralise the rupee leg ≈ lots × lot_g ÷ 31.1035 × $/oz ÷ 1,000.
tooltips.fnd: COMEX first notice day: a long held past it can be assigned delivery; brokers force out before.
tooltips.ltd: COMEX last trading day: third-last business day of the delivery month.
tooltips.basis_pct: MCX front settle ÷ duty-paid landed − 1 (995 purity, 15% duty dated), both legs at the settlement session's clock, which the panel names. Premium + carry + expectation. Context.
tooltips.carry_adj_pct: basis_pct minus the carry to expiry (≈ 6–7% p.a. in rupees): the part of the basis that is not interest.
tooltips.basis_carry_adj_pct: Carry-adjusted MCX basis: basis_pct minus the rupee carry to expiry.
tooltips.duty_pct: Customs duty rate applied on the ladder: 15% (BCD 10% + AIDC 5%) since 13 May 2026, Notification 16/2026-Customs. Dated; owner confirms at CBIC.
tooltips.duty_effective: The date the duty rate shown took effect (2026-05-13). A later date here means a new notification was loaded.
tooltips.duty_paid_landed: Landed ₹/10 g × (1 + duty): the cost of imported gold after the border; the base for the India premium and the MCX basis.
tooltips.settlement_session: The session the MCX settlement belongs to ('Thu 22 Oct settlement'), never the date of the ICICI file that carried it.
tooltips.session_label: Human label of the settlement's session. Monday's ICICI file is Friday's, carrying Thursday's settlement.
tooltips.comex_matched: The COMEX month that matches the MCX expiry (GOLD Dec-26 ↔ GCZ26) from the CME calendar; rolls to GCG27 around 25 Nov.
tooltips.comex_front: Yahoo continuous front month GC=F: rolls by Yahoo's rule a few days before first notice; last trade, not settlement.
tooltips.spot_proxy_note: There is no free gold 'spot' feed; the spot proxy is the COMEX front future. Says so wherever the number is used.
tooltips.crosscheck: gold-api.com XAU price and its timestamp (keyless, ≤ 1 call/min): a 24/7 sanity check on the Yahoo print, never the charted series.
tooltips.cot_mm_net: Managed-money net (long − short, spreads excluded) as of the report Tuesday, released Friday. Explains the week; does not forecast.
tooltips.cot_mm_chg: Week-on-week change in managed-money net. Negative with longs falling = long liquidation; the strip spells it out.
tooltips.cot_as_of: The report's Tuesday. The release is Friday 15:30 ET (Sat 01:00/02:00 IST); the page shows both and the next release.
tooltips.next_release_ist: When the next COT report lands in IST (Sat 01:00; 02:00 from 7 Nov 2026; Tue 02:00 after a US holiday Monday).
tooltips.stale: True when the newest COT report is older than its catalog max age (9 days): a shutdown or a missed release. Last stored values stay visible.
tooltips.driver_label: The larger of the two fund moves in the report week: new longs · short covering · funds sold into it (up-week); long liquidation · new shorts · funds bought the dip (down-week). Narration only.
tooltips.quadrant_label: Price Δ × OI Δ over the report week: long build-up / short covering / short build-up / long unwinding. Description, not forecast.
tooltips.who_did: The week's changes in words per group: 'closed 3,777 longs, covered 894 shorts'. Negative Δlong = longs closed; negative Δshort = shorts covered.
tooltips.net_moz: Net position in million troy ounces (contracts × 100 oz ÷ 1,000,000).
tooltips.net_t: Net position in tonnes (contracts × 100 oz × 31.1034768 g ÷ 1,000,000).
tooltips.net_usd_bn: Net position valued at the report-week price, $ bn.
tooltips.net_pct_oi: Net position as a share of total open interest. Managed money 25.9% on 20 Oct 2026.
tooltips.z52: Managed-money net in standard deviations from its 52-report mean. A crowdedness read with no forecasting power (G-STUDY).
tooltips.percentile_all: Where today's net sits among the COT reports in the window the label names (all history since 2006 when the full panel is read; else the fetched 3 years), 0–100. History, not a signal.
tooltips.options_overlay: One line from the combined report: options add N contracts to funds' net; combined OI. G-STUDY found no information in options-only positioning.
tooltips.spread_vs_front: This month's price minus the front month ($/oz): the calendar spread.
tooltips.annualised_carry_pct: (F2 ÷ F1 − 1) × 365 ÷ days between expiries, in % p.a. Contango is normal; a long pays it at each roll.
tooltips.ghost_1w: The same curve one week ago, drawn faint, so a steepening or flattening is visible without a second axis.
tooltips.margin_source: Where the margin number came from: zerodha_nrml (exchange NRML mirror, dated) for MCX; CME product reference (InitMargin) for COMEX.
tooltips.margin_date: The date the margin mirror was last updated; margins change daily and jump after exchange circulars.
tooltips.tender_start: First day of the MCX tender period for this expiry (the exchange circular is the legal source; the panel states the rule it used). Be out before the broker's cut-off.
tooltips.days_to_tender: Calendar days left before the tender period starts; once it has started, the days since (in tender). Roll before it starts.
tooltips.hedge_ratio_oz: Troy ounces of COMEX exposure per MCX lot: GOLD ≈ 32 oz, GOLDM ≈ 3.2, GOLDTEN ≈ 0.32. One GC contract ≈ 3.1 GOLD lots.
tooltips.one_pct_move_inr: Rupee P&L on one lot for a 1% move in the quote: price × multiplier ÷ 100, at the live price when the page holds one, else at the settlement proxy.
tooltips.diff_keys: The fields that change when you switch contract family: tick value, margin, cost %, liquidity, purity/settlement rule, hedge ratio.
tooltips.pure_gold_pct: KGX: the part of today's gold move not explained by the dollar basket (gold_usd + usd_effect).
tooltips.usd_effect_pct: KGX: the part of today's gold move that is the dollar moving (−Σ wᵢ Δln fᵢ with DXY weights). Identity, not a forecast.
tooltips.inr_effect_pct: The rupee leg of an MCX move: USD/INR change on the day. Identity.
tooltips.corr_60d: Correlation of the driver's daily change with gold's daily change over the last 60 sessions: how much the rule has been working lately.
tooltips.tag: supportive / headwind: the sign convention for gold (falling real yields and dollar = supportive), shown only on the MACRO driver strip with its rule.
tooltips.p_cut: Market-implied probability of a cut at that FOMC meeting (Atlanta Fed MPT from SOFR options, daily).
tooltips.p_hike: Market-implied probability of a hike at that meeting (Atlanta Fed MPT).
tooltips.after_mcx_close: True when the event lands after MCX closes (FOMC 00:30 IST in US winter): the move arrives as a gap at 09:00.
tooltips.in_session: True when the release falls inside MCX hours (US data at 18:00/19:00 IST): the move is tradable, not a gap.
tooltips.sigma_day_pct: One-standard-deviation day implied by GVZ: GVZ ÷ √252. 24 → ≈ 1.5% ≈ $61/oz ≈ ₹2,200 per 10 g.
tooltips.per_lot: The 1σ day in rupees per lot for GOLD / GOLDM / GOLDTEN / GUINEA / PETAL (× multiplier). Sizing arithmetic.
tooltips.freshness: Per block: source, as-of, age and state (live / delayed / stale / unavailable). Daily data shows its date, never a clock.
tooltips.badge: The evidence badge of the number: signal (none today) / context / arithmetic / heuristic (PLAN §f).
tooltips.evidence: The study and date the badge rests on, e.g. 'G-STUDY 26 Oct 2026: no forecasting power'.
tooltips.stale_baseline: Flag: the ICICI band midpoint and that session's last-30-min VWAP differ by more than 0.6 % — the band belonged to another session (the settlement check).
tooltips.settlement_source: Where the MCX settlement came from: last-30-min VWAP of the session's Breeze 1-minute bars (MCX's own method; a proxy) or the ICICI band midpoint.
tooltips.settlement_check: ICICI band midpoint vs the last-30-min VWAP: more than 0.6 % apart means the band belongs to another session; the page then uses the VWAP.
tooltips.band_midpoint: Midpoint of the ICICI master's ±3 % band, kept for reference and labelled with the session it really belongs to (set around an earlier settlement).
tooltips.basis_reference: The landed price the basis divides by, at the contract's own purity (landed_995 for GOLD/GOLDM, landed_999 …), so a 995 contract is never read against 999.
tooltips.trend_words: Where the price sits against both averages: below both averages / between / above both — printed with the distances, never the rule alone.
tooltips.inputs_json: Every input of that morning's fair-open call, kept for audit so a bad miss can be explained later.
tooltips.naive_error: Miss of the naive forecast (open = yesterday's settlement): the benchmark the model has to beat.
tooltips.mechanical: True on roll, expiry and exercise days, when OI changes for mechanical reasons; the quadrant label is greyed out.
tooltips.roll_ratio: Front-month OI ÷ next-month OI; falling fast = the roll is in progress.
tooltips.since: The date this history starts: every stored series begins the day its job first ran (the panel prints that date); nothing is backfilled from a chart.
tooltips.premium_pct: India dealer premium: IBJA 999 PM ÷ duty-paid landed (999-adjusted) − 1, both sampled at the IBJA fix minute. Context.
tooltips.premium_usd: Shanghai premium in $/oz: SGE PM (CNY/g × 31.1035 ÷ USDCNY) − the same date's LBMA PM or COMEX at 14:15 Beijing; 'awaiting today's PM' until both exist. Read changes, not the level.
tooltips.ts_sge: Timestamp of the SGE PM benchmark (14:15 Beijing = 11:45 IST) used in the Shanghai premium.
tooltips.ts_ref: Timestamp of the reference price (LBMA PM 15:00 London, or COMEX at 14:15 Beijing) — a 7-hour gap from SGE PM unless COMEX is used.
tooltips.balance_sheet: WGC quarterly supply (mine, recycled, hedging) vs demand (jewellery, technology, bar & coin, ETFs, central banks, OTC & other), tonnes.
tooltips.beta_regime: Weekly beta of gold to the driver in each regime (2003–09 / 2010–21 / 2022–26). The real-yield rule explains a third of what it used to since 2022; the dollar never stopped working.
tooltips.brent: Brent crude $/bbl: FRED dated spot (3–4 days behind) or, when fresher, the BZ=F front future (labelled). Inflation channel.
tooltips.cal_consensus: Consensus and previous print from the public calendar; actual when available.
tooltips.cal_in_session: Release lands while MCX is open (18:00–23:30 IST) or after the close (gap risk next morning).
tooltips.churn: Volume ÷ open interest: how many times the book turned over today. High churn = day-trading, not positioning.
tooltips.combined_oi: Futures + delta-adjusted options open interest (CFTC combined report).
tooltips.cot_pctile_all: Where today's net sits among the COT reports in the window named beside it (0–100). History, not a signal.
tooltips.cot_release: Positions as of Tuesday, released Friday 15:30 ET (Sat 01:00 IST; 02:00 IST from 7 Nov 2026). STALE after the catalog's max age (9 days).
tooltips.cot_z52: (net − 52-week mean) ÷ 52-week sd of net. |z| ≥ 2 = unusual for the year; no forecasting power (G-STUDY).
tooltips.d1: Change over the last session (bp for yields, % for prices).
tooltips.d1m: Change vs the stored value 30 calendar days earlier (the nearest earlier session; ≈ 21 sessions).
tooltips.d1w: Change vs the stored value 7 calendar days earlier (the nearest earlier session; ≈ 5 sessions).
tooltips.d_gld_t: Change in GLD tonnes over the span: the Western ETF buyer, contemporaneous with price.
tooltips.decomp_span: Change in each group's net, OI and GLD tonnes between two dates: since the last 2-year low and since the high.
tooltips.dgs2: US 2-year nominal yield: where the market thinks the Fed is going.
tooltips.driver_tag: supportive / headwind from the sign rule shown on the strip (e.g. real yield falling = supportive). A description of today, not a forecast.
tooltips.effr: Effective federal funds rate, previous session (FRED EFFR).
tooltips.efp_pct_volume: EFP round turns as % of the day's futures volume; 20-day average alongside.
tooltips.efp_rt: CME EFP (exchange for physical) round turns in gold today: futures swapped against London metal. Activity, not direction.
tooltips.etf_chg_1d: GLD tonnes today − yesterday: the daily creation/redemption print.
tooltips.etf_chg_1m: GLD tonnes vs the stored value 30 calendar days earlier (≈ 21 sessions).
tooltips.etf_flow_t: Net creations − redemptions in tonnes (WGC weekly by region). Contemporaneous with price; no lead (G-STUDY, G-MACRO).
tooltips.fed_mean_bp: Expected average policy rate to the horizon, printed as a rate level (416 bp = 4.16 %), not a move.
tooltips.fed_p_cut: Probability of a cut at that meeting from the Atlanta Fed Market Probability Tracker (SOFR options). FedWatch stays a link.
tooltips.fed_p_hike: Probability of a hike at that meeting (Atlanta Fed MPT).
tooltips.fed_target: Current target range for the federal funds rate.
tooltips.gold_in_ccy: Gold priced in another currency = $/oz × ccy per USD. Up in USD but down in EUR = it was the dollar.
tooltips.gold_m2_pct: Gold price ÷ US M2 as a percentile of the stored history (the panel names the span; over a short history it is noise). Context only.
tooltips.gpr_pct: Geopolitical Risk index (Caldara–Iacoviello) percentile of history, daily and monthly. No prediction (G-MACRO H4).
tooltips.hy_oas: US high-yield option-adjusted spread, %: risk-off context.
tooltips.ibja_999: IBJA 999 fine rate, ₹/10 g, afternoon (PM) board; compared with duty-paid landed × 0.999 (landed is fine gold).
tooltips.india_premium_pct: IBJA 999 PM ÷ duty-paid landed − 1, both legs at the IBJA fix minute (FBIL rate) and dated to that day. Above landed = local demand exceeds importable supply.
tooltips.kgx_inr_effect: The rupee leg for MCX: Δln(USD/INR) over the period. MCX gold = gold × rupee.
tooltips.kgx_pure_gold: Gold's move with the dollar's own move removed: total − USD effect.
tooltips.kgx_total: Gold's move in USD over the period, %.
tooltips.kgx_usd_effect: The part of gold's USD move explained by the dollar: −Σ wᵢ Δln(fᵢ) over the DXY basket (EUR 57.6 %, JPY 13.6 %, GBP 11.9 %, CAD 9.1 %, SEK 4.2 %, CHF 3.6 %).
tooltips.landed_999_vs_995: MCX GOLD/GOLDM are 995 fine, TEN/PETAL/GUINEA 999; each is compared with landed × its purity/1000. The ladder states which purity each step uses.
tooltips.mcx_basis_pct: MCX front settle ÷ duty-paid landed − 1, both at the settlement session's clock (named on the panel). Replaces the old 'implied premium 18 %' which ignored the duty.
tooltips.mcx_category_oi: MCX monthly category-wise OI (FPI / DFI / prop / hedgers / others): dormant until a collector exists (O-8).
tooltips.mcx_oi_by_expiry: MCX open interest per contract and expiry in lots, from ICICI's security master each morning (07:35). History since the job started.
tooltips.micro_gold: MICRO GOLD (MGC, 10 oz) managed-money net: the retail-sized read of the same report.
tooltips.move_per_lot: 1σ day in rupees per lot = σ% × ₹/10 g × multiplier (GOLD 100, GOLDM 10, GOLDTEN 1, GUINEA 0.8, PETAL 0.1).
tooltips.net_by_group: Net position (long − short) of each CFTC trader group, contracts, stacked by report week; the five disaggregated groups sum to zero against the spreads. Description, not forecast.
tooltips.next_fomc_ist: Next FOMC decision in IST (23:30 on US daylight time, 00:30 after 1 Nov): after the MCX close = gap risk at 09:00.
tooltips.official_chg: Change in ounces vs the prior reported month: the central bank's net purchase or sale.
tooltips.official_oz: Official monetary gold holdings, million troy ounces (IMF IRFCL), each with its data month (1–2 month lag).
tooltips.oi_by_product: COMEX open interest per product (GC 100 oz, MGC 10 oz, 1OZ, QO 50 oz, OG options), all months summed; T+1 from CME FTP.
tooltips.pboc_streak: Consecutive months of reported PBoC gold additions (SAFE ~7th; IMF a month later).
tooltips.pc_oi: Put OI ÷ call OI on COMEX gold options (OG). A ratio, not a forecast.
tooltips.pct_1y: Where today's level sits among its stored values of the last 365 calendar days (≈ 252 sessions), 0–100.
tooltips.rbi_gold_share: Gold as % of RBI's total foreign-exchange reserves.
tooltips.rbi_gold_usd: RBI gold reserves at RBI's valuation, US$ mn (Weekly Statistical Supplement, Friday). Weekly changes are almost all price.
tooltips.rolling_corr: Rolling 1-year correlation of gold's daily change with the driver's daily change, by year.
tooltips.season_hit_rate: Share of years the month closed up.
tooltips.season_mean: Mean monthly return of gold in that calendar month since 1971 (World Bank spliced with GC=F). Dec/Jan strong historically; no month passes in both halves (G-MACRO H3).
tooltips.sge_premium_pct: Shanghai premium as % of the London/COMEX reference. Read sign flips and changes; the level depends on import quotas.
tooltips.sge_td_direction: SGE Au(T+D) settlement direction: Short to Long = shorts pay the deferred fee = physical tightness; Long to Short = the opposite.
tooltips.shfe_oi: SHFE gold front-contract open interest in lots (1 kg each); Δ vs prior session.
tooltips.traders_short: Number of reportable traders short in this category: breadth of the other side.
tooltips.volume_vs_20d: Today's volume ÷ its 20-session average. > 1.5 = an active day; says nothing about direction.
tooltips.week_price_chg: GC front-month change Tuesday to Tuesday, the week the report describes.
tooltips.wgc_region_flow: WGC weekly fund flows by region (NA / Europe / Asia / Other) in tonnes, for the week ended Friday.
tooltips.zq_implied: Fed funds futures (ZQ): implied rate = 100 − price; the continuous ZQ=F rolls, so it is labelled by contract, not by date.
tooltips.positions_opened_closed: OI up over the period = positions opened, OI down = closed (lots, this contract). Every lot has a buyer and a seller: exchange OI never says who is long or short.
tooltips.oi_share: This expiry's share of the family's open interest on the latest stored session, live expiries only: where the open positions sit. Lots on hover.
tooltips.mcx_daily_close: Close of the period's last session from ICICI Breeze daily bars (a broker bar, not MCX's official settlement), in the contract's quote unit.
tooltips.h.verdict: One rule-based sentence: what moved and who was behind it. Each clause is a threshold on a stored series. Describes, does not predict.
tooltips.h.gauges: Eight context tiles with 60-day sparks: trend, real yield, dollar, positioning, India basis, Shanghai premium, ETF holdings, curve/roll. No score.
tooltips.h.open: Today's open: where MCX should open given COMEX and the rupee since the close (arithmetic). The OK/WAIT strip is a house rule (₹300) with its measured miss: arithmetic to read, not advice.
tooltips.h.accuracy: Has the 08:45 call been any good? Median/mean/p90 miss, % within the limit, bias, model vs naive. Needs ≈ 20 rows to mean anything.
tooltips.h.moved: What moved since the MCX close: the COMEX part and the rupee part of the overnight gap, in ₹ per 10 g.
tooltips.h.events: Event risk, next 7 days in IST: FOMC, US CPI/NFP/PCE, COT release, MCX expiries, COMEX FND/LTD, Budget, festivals; after-close = gap risk at 09:00.
tooltips.h.headlines: Gold-topic headlines, last 24 h, with the risk-word count as a heuristic chip. A keyword tally, not sentiment.
tooltips.h.brief: Today's automated brief (bias, confidence, overnight summary, open plan, key risks) when one exists. Labelled automated with its confidence.
tooltips.d.24h: Kitco-style chart from stored bars: 24 h … all, USD/oz, ₹/10 g (ex-duty or duty-paid), ₹/g, USD/g, USD/kg; hi/lo/change, previous close dashed, session bands on 24 h. Kitco is a link.
tooltips.d.3day: Three days overlaid on one 24-hour IST axis, one colour each: today's path against the last two, hour by hour.
tooltips.d.sge: Shanghai Au99.99 delayed intraday line on the Shanghai band (CNY/g → $/oz): does Shanghai lead or lag the COMEX print.
tooltips.d.quadrant: Yesterday's OI × price read: long build-up / short covering / short build-up / long unwinding for COMEX GC and the MCX family; roll days greyed. Context.
tooltips.d.tape: Last 12 five-minute bars: time, last, change, range, volume.
tooltips.w.candles: 60 sessions of daily candles (GC front) with MCX settle, 20/50-day lines and volume; Mondays shaded.
tooltips.w.table: Mon ▸ Fri: OHLC, change, range, COMEX volume and OI change, MCX OI change, IBJA PM, GLD tonnes change, COT (Friday). CSV export.
tooltips.w.grid: 26-week heat grid of daily changes with the week's total.
tooltips.w.whodid: The weekly 'who did what' line, echoed from POSITIONING (same component, rendered once per view).
tooltips.m.candles: Monthly candles since 2000 (log scale); rupee toggle via GOLDBEES or landed cost.
tooltips.m.ladder: Return ladder 3d · 7d · 30d · 60d · 6m · 1y · 5y · 10y · 15y in $, ₹ and the DXY basket. Context.
tooltips.m.season: Mean monthly return and hit rate since 1971; Indian festival months marked. No month passes in both halves; walk-forward best-6-months +0.3%/yr. Context only.
tooltips.m.official: Central-bank net purchases by country over 12 months (each with its data month), the PBoC streak, RBI tonnes and weekly value.
tooltips.m.physical: Monthly physical flow: SGE withdrawals, India imports, Swiss exports to India, AMFI gold-ETF flow and AUM in tonnes, London vault change.
tooltips.m.balance: WGC quarterly balance sheet: supply (mine, recycled, hedging) vs demand (jewellery, technology, bar & coin, ETFs, central banks, OTC & other). Attributed.
tooltips.m.liquidity: Collapsed context: gold/M2 percentile, HY credit spread, geopolitical-risk percentile, inflation-expectation models.
tooltips.p.hero: Managed-money net in contracts, Moz, t and $bn; the week's change in words; the fund-driver label (the larger leg); OI; as-of, released and next release in IST. Explains the week — does not forecast.
tooltips.p.whois: Who is long, who is short: paired bars per trader group (managed money, other reportables, non-reportable, swap dealers, producer/merchant) with closed/covered/new chips.
tooltips.p.history: Three stacked panels, one axis each: price, net by group, managed-money COT index with 20/80 bands. Ranges 1y / 3y / 10y / all.
tooltips.p.crowd: Crowdedness gauge: 52-week COT index, z-scores, net % of OI, a percentile over the window it names. Not a signal — no forecasting power 2006–2026 (G-STUDY). Never coloured.
tooltips.p.decomp: Rally and decline decomposed: who added or cut since the last 2-year low and since the high — funds, commercials, other reportables, small specs, OI, GLD.
tooltips.p.daily.comex: Daily COMEX OI by product (GC, MGC, 1OZ, QO, options P/C) with the OI change against price: 'which positions got closed yesterday'. T+1; mechanical on expiry days.
tooltips.p.daily.mcx: MCX OI by contract and expiry (lots), the change, the roll ratio and days to tender; history since the job started. Proxy settlement, no volume.
tooltips.p.mcx.history: MCX positions opened / closed in the picked contract by session, ISO week or month (Breeze daily OI × close, the tape's quadrant word) and where the family's OI sits. Describes, does not predict.
tooltips.p.mcx.category: Who holds MCX gold by participant category (FPI, DFI, prop, hedgers, others). Dormant: the monthly MCX workbook needs a collector (owner decision O-8); the link is shown.
tooltips.p.asia: SHFE front-month OI change; SGE Au(T+D) OI and which side pays the deferred fee ('Short to Long' = physical tightness).
tooltips.p.drawer: Details: trader counts and average size, top-4/8 concentration, micro gold, the options overlay line, the raw CFTC block and API query. Weekly; no daily, no OTC; no timing value found.
tooltips.ph.ladder: The India price stack: COMEX → × USD/INR → landed → + duty 15% (dated) → duty-paid → IBJA premium → MCX basis, each bar with its own clock; a derived % names its clock (fix minute / settlement).
tooltips.ph.india: India premium history (IBJA vs duty-paid landed) with duty steps marked, the WGC weekly premium and the Reuters survey as sanity lines; MCX basis history.
tooltips.ph.shanghai: Shanghai premium ($/oz and %) from the SGE PM benchmark vs the same date's London PM or COMEX at 14:15 Beijing, both timestamps shown; the SGE PM in CNY/g and $/oz.
tooltips.ph.etf: GLD tonnes daily since 2004 with daily changes; IAU; WGC weekly flows by region and the India tonnes; top inflow/outflow fund. Contemporaneous, no lead.
tooltips.ph.official: Official sector: top holders and last-month buyers from the IMF (ounces, each with its data month), PBoC streak, RBI weekly value and share.
tooltips.ph.otc: The OTC window: LBMA weekly turnover (12-week average), London vault tonnes (monthly), CME EFP prints. Activity and stock, not positions; no COT exists for London.
tooltips.ph.comex.stocks: COMEX warehouse stocks and deliveries (registered / eligible / pledged, coverage ratio): link-only tiles until the owner resolves CME's block (O-2).
tooltips.ph.links: Publishers with no free feed or licensed data: PHYS, US Mint, SwissImpex, LBMA detail, WGC GDT, SAFE, HK C&SD, Kitco. Links, never fetched.
tooltips.mc.drivers: Driver strip: 10-y real yield, 2-y, breakeven, the dollar (the series used is named on the tile), USD/INR, GVZ, Brent, GLD — supportive/headwind tag and 60-day correlation. Contemporaneous.
tooltips.mc.kgx: 'Gold or the dollar?': today's, the week's and the month's move split into pure gold, the dollar basket and (for MCX) the rupee leg. Identity, not a forecast.
tooltips.mc.ccy: Gold in USD, INR (landed ₹/10 g), EUR, JPY, GBP, CNY over 1d / 1w / 1m / YTD: up in dollars but down in euros means it was the dollar.
tooltips.mc.fed: The Fed path: per-meeting cut/hike probabilities (Atlanta Fed), fed-funds futures implied rates, EFFR and the target range; next FOMC in IST.
tooltips.mc.calendar: US releases this week in IST with consensus and previous (actual when available); in-session vs after-close flag.
tooltips.mc.move: Expected move: GVZ → a 1σ day in %, $/oz, ₹/10 g and ₹ per lot for each MCX family; realised 20-day vol; ATR14 in rupees. Sizing arithmetic.
tooltips.mc.health: Driver health, weekly: rolling 1-year correlation of gold with real yields and the dollar; betas by regime (2003–09 / 2010–21 / 2022–26). The real-yield rule weakened after 2022.
tooltips.mc.context: Collapsed: gold/silver and gold/platinum with percentiles, gold vs real-yield scatter, geopolitical-risk percentiles, HY spread, gold/M2.
tooltips.c.selector: Exchange × family × expiry pickers (GOLD, GOLDM, GOLDTEN, GUINEA, PETAL, options): lot, purity, expiries, tick value, OI, NRML margin (dated), round-trip cost, hedge ratio; a diff strip on switch.
tooltips.c.comex: COMEX term structure (six months) with last week's ghost curve, calendar spreads, implied carry p.a. 'Last trade, not settlement' until the bulletin is allowed.
tooltips.c.mcx: MCX chain: expiry, settle (proxy/official), band, OI and change, implied carry; today vs a week ago; roll warning when the front empties faster than the next fills.
tooltips.c.roll: Roll calendar with countdowns: MCX expiries, COMEX first intent / FND / LTD in IST, 1OZ/QO LTD, the broker's tender cut-off (owner), the Pre-Open desk's month mapping.
tooltips.c.spec: DES-style card for the matched COMEX contract: size, settlement method, tick, initial margin and % of notional (daily), EFP/block eligibility, margin history.
tooltips.c.links: Linked, not fetched: TradingView GC1!, CME FedWatch and contract pages, MCX circulars, QuikStrike/CVOL, DGCX, JPX.
